```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    GLOBAL NCD BURDEN (2019, pre-COVID)                      │
│                                                                             │
│  All deaths globally: ~55 million/year                                      │
│  NCD deaths: ~41 million (74%)                                              │
│                                                                             │
│  TOP NCD KILLERS (global deaths/year):                                      │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │  Cardiovascular disease         18.6M   ████████████████████████   │     │
│  │  Cancers                         9.9M   █████████████             │     │
│  │  Chronic respiratory disease     3.9M   █████                     │     │
│  │  Diabetes mellitus               2.0M   ███                       │     │
│  │  Neurological conditions         1.7M   ██                        │     │
│  │  Other NCDs                      5.9M   ████████                  │     │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
│                                                                               │
│  80% of NCD deaths occur in LMICs                                            │
│  70% of NCD deaths involve people under age 70 (premature mortality)         │
│                                                                               │
│  SHARED RISK FACTORS (WHO "best buys"):                                      │
│  Tobacco ─────────→ CVD, all cancers, COPD, stroke                          │
│  Alcohol ─────────→ Liver, cancers, CVD, injury                             │
│  Physical inactivity → CVD, diabetes, cancers                               │
│  Unhealthy diet ──→ CVD, diabetes, obesity, cancers                        │
│  Air pollution ───→ COPD, CVD, lung cancer                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
